verdict.rationale: Highnote documents creating and managing virtual, physical, and tokenized cards through a GraphQL API, and its agentic-commerce page says cards are issued via API and close automatically when a workflow ends, which implies programmatic closure. Beyond issuance and closure, the evidence does not cover the specific lifecycle transitions the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented activate mutation, pause/unpause (suspend) operations, report lost or stolen flow, reissue with a replacement linked to the original, explicit permanent-close API docs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
